HARNESS FACTS LEARNED (not in the repo): the ownership guard refuses git or writes inside a worktree that is not the session primary directory; run a bare cd <worktree> in its own call (the harness then updates the primary directory), then work there. Shell-built arguments (cp targets, mkdir) are refused: write scripts to the scratchpad with literal paths and run them with bash <literal path>. A composed git push is refused: push bare. macOS sed needs -i with an empty suffix, so edit with python. The shell is bash, not zsh. quest writes need --actor lore-cli --actor-kind delegated-agent --accountable-human jdnewhouse; task create takes the title first. ubuntu CI red with no (fail) line and exit 124 is the known hang/race flake: rerun the failed job once and read the new attempt. A reviewer verdict must be recorded verbatim with its sha256. Workstation quest is 0.14.1, so the 3 LCLI-614 real-quest unlink tests fail locally only. Write mutants as a script with a predicted red set and a clean-tree check; a mutant that stays green means the test pins nothing (twice this session an ASCII fixture hid a fold bug: lower(STRASSE) equals fold(straße), so use the same-spelling case).
